{{Quote|Cliegg Lars. Everyone heard about it. Moisture farmer over on the other side of Jawa Heights.|[[Orrin Gault]]|<ref name="Kenobi">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>}}
'''Jawa Heights''' was a tableland located on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|143|Jawa Heights}}</ref> It was located on the border between the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] and the [[Great Chott salt flat/Legends|Great Chott salt flat]],<ref name="ItWoSWR" /> several hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] west of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. The Jawa Heights was named after the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] that gathered at that location to take advantage of the shade that was found there.<ref name="TCSWE" /> In his youth, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used his [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] to bulls-eye [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] in the Jawa Heights.<ref name="ItWoSWR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The first image of the article "[[Visual Guides|Visual Guide]] &mdash; Chapter 8: Droids for Sale" identified one of the location seen in {{Film|IV}} as the Jawa Heights. Unfortunately, the individual images of the article were not available anymore.<ref name="VG">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp08.html|text=Visual Guide &mdash; Chapter 8: Droids for Sale}}</ref>
